title: PerfArena: Ranking LLMs by Code Performance
abstract: arXiv:2611.18030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industry now relies on LLMs to write a large share of production code. Although that code is mostly, but not always, correct, correctness alone does not determine whether it is fit for repeated and extensive use, which depends on what the code costs in time, memory and energy. Most code-generation benchmarks nonetheless evaluate correctness in isolation, and most performance-oriented benchmarks cover few languages and rarely measure energy consumption. To address this gap, we present PERFARENA, an open-source, reproducible arena that ranks LLMs by the performance of their generated code across multiple languages and competitions. PERFARENA executes the solutions of each LLM on a Unix-like host and reports correctness together with latency, peak memory, and energy consumption. translated_title: PerfArena：按代码性能对大语言模型进行排名
translated_abstract: 当前业界已依赖大语言模型（LLM）编写大量生产代码。尽管这些代码大部分情况下是正确的，但并非总是如此，而且仅有正确性并不能决定代码是否适合被反复和广泛使用，这还取决于代码在时间、内存和能耗上的开销。然而，大多数代码生成基准只单独评估正确性，而大多数面向性能的基准覆盖的语言较少，且很少测量能耗。为填补这一空白，我们提出了PERFARENA，一个开源、可复现的竞技场，它根据LLM所生成代码的性能在多种语言和竞赛中对模型进行排名。PERFARENA在类Unix主机上执行每个LLM的解答，并报告正确性以及延迟、峰值内存和能耗。在PERFARENA中，正确性判定器、性能判定器、性能分析器和代码生成工作流均是可插拔的，从而能够集成新的评判后端。
tldr: PERFARENA是一个开源、可复现的评测竞技场，通过测量LLM生成代码在多种语言和竞赛中的延迟、峰值内存与能耗等性能指标来对模型排名，弥补了现有基准仅关注正确性、语言覆盖窄且忽略能耗的不足。
en_tdlr: PerfArena is an open-source, reproducible arena that ranks LLMs by the latency, peak memory, and energy consumption of their generated code across multiple languages and competitions, addressing the gap left by correctness-only benchmarks.
